_doc: Shared macro input map (2026-10-14). instruments = TradingView scanner tickers (live-verified 2026-10-14 via stock-api/src/clients/TradingViewClient.js getPerformance). industries = first-match-wins regex over company-master `sector` + ' | ' + `industry`; each maps to the instruments whose QoQ move most plausibly moves that industry's revenue (realisation) or margin (input cost). `role`: input_cost (rise = margin headwind unless passed through), realisation (rise = revenue/margin tailwind), fx_revenue (USDINR up = tailwind for USD billers), rate (IN10Y/repo proxy: up = funding-cost headwind). `lagQuarters` = typical pass-through lag (judgment default; the agent overrides from the concall). This is a STARTING basket — pead-predictor's agent adds/removes instruments from the company's own concall (RM mix) via --extra-tickers.

industries.note: Metal is largely passed through via price-variation clauses (revenue moves with metal); margin hit comes from inventory/lag and fixed-price orders (kb:1b89c3ec, kb:4e67b69f)
